pairs.l: 1 — thought that their exchange was both an exciting and daunting experience?
2 — says studying abroad made them work harder?
3 — appreciated the work schedule at the university they attended?
4 — joined the exchange programme to expand their employment opportunities?
5 — decided to stay in their host country?
6 — discovered the style of teaching that suited them most during their exchange?
7 — suggests that learning a new language is an important benefit of exchanges?
8 — stresses the importance of making new acquaintances in an exchange?
9 — visited places during their exchange programme?
10 — changed their outlook on major problems in the world?
11 — found that managing to live independently was an important advantage of their exchange?
12 — got to know themselves better during the exchange programme?

r1.exp: 1=C (Caterina: 'GREAT ASSET, it can be very SCARY at times' = exciting and daunting). 2=A (Adèle: 'push myself to DO BETTER, putting more time in writing research papers'). 3=F (Frédéric: 'I PREFERRED that most of my classes started after midday'). 4=D (Darin: 'companies are looking for students with international experience... result in A BETTER JOB OFFER'). 5=A (Adèle: ostaje na doktorat — 'staying for PhD' = konkretna odluka da ostane; Editino 'if it WERE UP TO ME' je samo hipotetski, dakle NE ostaje). 6=E (Edita: 'it was good to find out that a MORE HANDS-ON RESEARCH-BASED APPROACH worked better for me'). 7=D (Darin: 'understanding of different cultures, which you can do properly only IF YOU SPEAK THEIR LANGUAGE'). 8=B (Benicio: 'getting to know people you can RELY ON after you graduate is a great asset as they may BECOME AN IMPORTANT NETWORK'). 9=B (Benicio: 'I made it my priority to find opportunities for... TRAVELLING as well'). 10=F (Frédéric: 'spending a semester abroad... SHIFTED MY PERSPECTIVE for good'). 11=C (Caterina: 'learning to cope with EVERYDAY PROBLEMS ON YOUR OWN... it's a GREAT ASSET'). 12=E (Edita: 'in a different country you see yourself in ways you never could have before. AND I LIKE WHAT I SEE').

r13.exp: 'I DIDN'T FEEL RESTRICTED like when we used to play in the street' = dala joj osjećaj slobode = B.

r14.exp: 'Not suitable for being kept in zoos – UNLESS THEY ARE BEING THREATENED IN THE WILD, which is NOW BECOMING A REALITY' = ugrožene životinje trebaju biti u zoovima = A.

r15.exp: 'Campaigning vigorously for a SHARP ACCELERATION in the return of captive animals to the wild' = trebaju se brže vratiti u stanište = B.

r16.exp: 'Wild areas degraded by agriculture, animals threatened by disease or squeezed into tiny areas... conflict with humans' = originalna staništa više nisu pogodna = A.

r17.exp: 'After deducting running costs, £1.5m IS SPENT ON GOVERNMENT PROGRAMMES for studying chimpanzees and reintroducing black rhinos' = dio prihoda od posjetitelja ide na konzervaciju = D.

r18.exp: 'Zoos do have a role to play as ARKS FOR THREATENED WILDLIFE' = trebaju ostati kao utočišta za ugrožene životinje = C.

r19.exp: 'Most people keep a close eye on weather reports and take cover. (19)___. When a tornado happens, THEY WANT TO BE THERE to observe and record it.' → B: Storm chasers keep AN EVEN CLOSER EYE on weather data, BUT FOR A DIFFERENT REASON.

r20.exp: 'Professional chasers have meteorological training. (20)___. They ALSO learn by chasing with other experienced chasers.' → C: They KNOW WHEN CONDITIONS ARE SAFE AND WHEN IT'S TIME TO BACK OFF.

r21.exp: 'A tornado is a swirling mass of air. (21)___. Most frequently they tend to happen in the LATE EVENING or during the NIGHT.' → E: Tornadoes CAN HAPPEN ANYWHERE AND AT ANY TIME.

r22.exp: 'Cold air at high altitudes is a promising sign. (22)___. Then they hop into their chase vehicle.' → G: AFTER ANALYSING THE WEATHER DATA, the chasers SELECT A LIKELY PATH.

r23.exp: 'ONE is the anticlockwise rotation of clouds. (23)___. THEY don't always produce tornadoes, but they're a sign.' → F: ANOTHER is a WALL CLOUD, a cloud that SEEMS TO DESCEND FROM THE BOTTOM OF THE STORM.

r24.exp: 'Chasers might have time to look for a good place to observe the tornado. (24)___. Once a funnel cloud forms, one will track its movement.' → D: IDEALLY, they would SET UP ON A HILL ABOUT THREE MILES AWAY to get the best view.

r25.exp: 'They MIGHT be moving abroad' — 'might' za mogućnost/spekulaciju (one of several possible reasons).

r26.exp: 'Pick UP a second language' — frazalni glagol: pick up = naučiti (jezik) neformalno, usput.

r27.exp: 'Might not make you LEARN faster' — causative: make + object + bare infinitive (make you learn).

r28.exp: 'Set your GOALS' — fiksna kolokacija: set goals = postaviti ciljeve.

r29.exp: 'Fancied TRYING their hand at' — 'fancy' + gerund (fiksna gramatička struktura: fancy + -ing).

r30.exp: 'Without DOUBT the best way to learn' — fiksni izraz: without doubt = nedvojbeno, nesumnjivo.

r31.exp: 'If you only ever PRACTISE with another language learner' — conditional 1: if + present simple → will. 'Practise' = present simple.

r32.exp: 'When you TAKE the time to find a native speaker' — fiksna kolokacija: take the time to = odvojiti/uzeti si vremena.

r33.exp: 'Increasing your capacity FOR mindfulness' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: capacity for = kapacitet za.

r34.exp: 'Capacity to deal WITH adverse events' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: deal with = nositi se s, savladati.

r35.exp: 'BY focusing on the here and now' — 'by' + gerund za načinski prilog (kako? — fokusirajući se).

r36.exp: 'They are LESS preoccupied with concerns about success' — 'less' = manje (komparativ malo).

r37.exp: 'As IF greater well-being isn't enough of an incentive' — fiksni izraz: as if = kao da (implies it IS enough but they're adding more).

r38.exp: 'There is more THAN one way to practise mindfulness' — komparativna konstrukcija: more than = više od.

r39.exp: 'Paying attention to the THOUGHTS we base our judgements on' — 'thoughts' = misli (na temelju kojih donosimo prosudbe).

r40.exp: 'Directing attention to moment-to-moment SENSATIONS during everyday activities' — 'sensations' = osjeti, tjelesne/osjetilne senzacije.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA ekološku štetu kao cijenu: industrijski razvoj, rast populacije, globalizacija, teško izbjeći. ZA razvoj bez štete: obnovljiva energija, zelene tehnologije, cirkularna ekonomija, promjene u ponašanju. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
